campos.descripcion: Anchor links should scroll smoothly to target section
campos.hacer: Use scroll-behavior: smooth on html element

campos.descripcion: Fixed nav should not obscure content
campos.hacer: Add padding-top to body equal to nav height
campos.no_hacer: Let nav overlap first section content

campos.descripcion: Current page/section should be visually indicated
campos.hacer: Highlight active nav item with color/underline
campos.no_hacer: No visual feedback on current location

campos.descripcion: Users expect back to work predictably
campos.hacer: Preserve navigation history properly

campos.descripcion: URLs should reflect current state for sharing
campos.hacer: Update URL on state/view changes

campos.descripcion: Show user location in site hierarchy
campos.hacer: Use for sites with 3+ levels of depth

campos.descripcion: Too many animations cause distraction and motion sickness
campos.hacer: Animate 1-2 key elements per view maximum

campos.descripcion: Motion duration depends on distance complexity platform and user context
campos.hacer: Use shared motion tokens and test that feedback stays responsive
campos.no_hacer: Present 150-300ms or any cutoff as a universal requirement

campos.descripcion: Respect user's motion preferences
campos.hacer: Check prefers-reduced-motion media query

campos.descripcion: Show feedback during async operations
campos.hacer: Use skeleton screens or spinners
campos.no_hacer: Leave UI frozen with no feedback

campos.descripcion: Hover effects don't work on touch devices
campos.hacer: Use click/tap for primary interactions
campos.no_hacer: Rely only on hover for important actions

campos.descripcion: Infinite animations are distracting
campos.hacer: Use for loading indicators only

campos.descripcion: Some CSS properties trigger expensive repaints
campos.hacer: Use transform and opacity for animations

campos.descripcion: Easing should match how an element changes speed and purpose
campos.hacer: Use deceleration when arriving acceleration when leaving and linear for constant-rate progress
campos.no_hacer: Reject linear easing even for steady rotation or progress

campos.descripcion: Stacking context conflicts cause hidden elements
campos.hacer: Define z-index scale system (10 20 30 50)

campos.descripcion: Hidden overflow can clip important content
campos.hacer: Test all content fits within containers

campos.descripcion: Fixed elements can overlap or be inaccessible
campos.hacer: Account for safe areas and other fixed elements

campos.descripcion: New stacking contexts reset z-index
campos.hacer: Understand what creates new stacking context
campos.no_hacer: Expect z-index to work across contexts

campos.descripcion: Images badges validation text and skeleton replacements can shift nearby content when they update
campos.hacer: Reserve appropriate space or keep async states in a stable content-driven container
campos.no_hacer: Insert compact text or media without a layout strategy

campos.descripcion: 100vh can be problematic on mobile browsers
campos.hacer: Use dvh or account for mobile browser chrome

campos.descripcion: Content too wide is hard to read
campos.hacer: Limit max-width for text content (65-75ch)
campos.no_hacer: Let text span full viewport width

campos.descripcion: Touch target guidance depends on platform and web context
campos.hacer: Use 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android; for web use the separate WCAG Target Size rule
campos.no_hacer: Treat one unit or minimum as universal across platforms

campos.descripcion: Adjacent touch targets need adequate spacing
campos.hacer: Minimum 8px gap between touch targets

campos.descripcion: Custom gestures can conflict with system
campos.hacer: Avoid horizontal swipe on main content

campos.descripcion: 300ms tap delay feels laggy
campos.hacer: Use touch-action CSS or fastclick

campos.descripcion: Accidental refresh is frustrating
campos.hacer: Disable where not needed

campos.descripcion: Tactile feedback improves interaction feel
campos.hacer: Use for confirmations and important actions

campos.descripcion: Keyboard focus, including controls inside a modal, needs a visible indicator
campos.hacer: Use a visible focus ring on every interactive control, including modal controls

campos.descripcion: Visual feedback on interactive elements
campos.hacer: Change cursor and add subtle visual change
campos.no_hacer: No hover feedback on clickable elements

campos.descripcion: Show immediate feedback on press/click
campos.hacer: Add pressed/active state visual change

campos.descripcion: Clearly indicate non-interactive elements
campos.hacer: Reduce opacity and change cursor

campos.descripcion: Prevent double submission during async actions
campos.hacer: Disable button and show loading state

campos.descripcion: Users need to know when something fails
campos.hacer: Show clear error messages near problem

campos.descripcion: Confirm successful actions to users
campos.hacer: Show success message or visual change

campos.descripcion: Prevent accidental destructive actions
campos.hacer: Confirm before delete/irreversible actions

campos.descripcion: Text must be readable against background
campos.hacer: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text

campos.descripcion: Don't convey information by color alone
campos.hacer: Use icons/text in addition to color

campos.descripcion: Images need text alternatives
campos.hacer: Descriptive alt text for meaningful images

campos.descripcion: Screen readers use headings for navigation
campos.hacer: Use sequential heading levels h1-h6
campos.no_hacer: Skip heading levels or misuse for styling

campos.descripcion: Interactive elements need accessible names
campos.hacer: Add aria-label for icon-only buttons

campos.descripcion: Web users need complete keyboard navigation with visible focus on every operable control
campos.hacer: Keep tab order aligned with visual order and test every action without a pointer
campos.no_hacer: Keyboard traps or illogical tab order

campos.descripcion: Content should make sense when read aloud
campos.hacer: Use semantic HTML and ARIA properly

campos.descripcion: Inputs must have associated labels
campos.hacer: Use label with for attribute or wrap input

campos.descripcion: Error messages must be announced
campos.hacer: Use aria-live or role=alert for errors

campos.descripcion: Allow keyboard users to skip navigation
campos.hacer: Provide skip to main content link
campos.no_hacer: No skip link on nav-heavy pages

campos.descripcion: Large images slow page load
campos.hacer: Use appropriate size and format (WebP)

campos.descripcion: Load content as needed
campos.hacer: Lazy load below-fold images and content

campos.descripcion: Large bundles slow initial load
campos.hacer: Split code by route/feature

campos.descripcion: Repeat visits should be fast
campos.hacer: Set appropriate cache headers

campos.descripcion: Web fonts can block rendering
campos.hacer: Use font-display swap or optional

campos.descripcion: External scripts can block rendering
campos.hacer: Load non-critical scripts async/defer

campos.descripcion: Large JavaScript slows interaction
campos.hacer: Monitor and minimize bundle size

campos.descripcion: CSS/JS can block first paint
campos.hacer: Inline critical CSS defer non-critical

campos.descripcion: Every input needs a visible label
campos.hacer: Always show label above or beside input

campos.descripcion: Each invalid field needs an inline error connected to that field
campos.hacer: Show a specific error below the input and reference it with aria-describedby
campos.no_hacer: Show only a top-level error without identifying each invalid field

campos.descripcion: Validate as user types or on blur
campos.hacer: Validate on blur for most fields

campos.descripcion: Use appropriate input types
campos.hacer: Use email tel number url etc

campos.descripcion: Help browsers autofill correctly
campos.hacer: Use autocomplete attribute properly

campos.descripcion: Mark required fields clearly
campos.hacer: Use asterisk or (required) text

campos.descripcion: Let users see password while typing
campos.hacer: Toggle to show/hide password

campos.descripcion: Confirm form submission status
campos.hacer: Show loading then success/error state

campos.descripcion: Inputs should look interactive
campos.hacer: Use distinct input styling
campos.no_hacer: Inputs that look like plain text

campos.descripcion: Show appropriate keyboard for input type
campos.hacer: Use inputmode attribute

campos.descripcion: Design for mobile then enhance for larger
campos.hacer: Start with mobile styles then add breakpoints

campos.descripcion: Test at all common screen sizes
Mobile layouts need touch-sized targets
campos.hacer: Increase touch targets on mobile

campos.descripcion: Text must be readable on all devices
campos.hacer: Minimum 16px body text on mobile

campos.descripcion: Set viewport for mobile devices
campos.hacer: Use width=device-width initial-scale=1

campos.descripcion: Avoid horizontal scrolling
campos.hacer: Ensure content fits viewport width

campos.descripcion: Images should scale with container
campos.hacer: Use max-width: 100% on images

campos.descripcion: Tables can overflow on mobile
campos.hacer: Use horizontal scroll or card layout

campos.descripcion: Adequate line height improves readability
campos.hacer: Use 1.5-1.75 for body text

campos.descripcion: Long lines are hard to read
campos.hacer: Limit to 65-75 characters per line

campos.descripcion: Consistent type hierarchy aids scanning
campos.hacer: Use consistent modular scale

campos.descripcion: Fonts should load without layout shift
campos.hacer: Reserve space with fallback font

campos.descripcion: Body text needs good contrast
campos.hacer: Use darker text on light backgrounds

campos.descripcion: Headings should stand out from body
campos.hacer: Clear size/weight difference

campos.descripcion: Loading feedback should match the expected wait and avoid flashing for near-instant work
campos.hacer: Follow platform and component guidance; preserve layout focus and accessible busy status
campos.no_hacer: Apply one timing threshold to every operation or leave long waits unexplained

campos.descripcion: Guide users when no content exists
campos.hacer: Show helpful message and action

campos.descripcion: Help users recover from errors
campos.hacer: Provide clear next steps

campos.descripcion: Show progress for multi-step processes
campos.hacer: Step indicators or progress bar

campos.descripcion: Transient messages for non-critical info
campos.hacer: Auto-dismiss after 3-5 seconds

campos.descripcion: Confirm successful actions
campos.hacer: Brief success message

campos.descripcion: Handle long content gracefully
campos.hacer: Truncate with ellipsis and expand option

campos.descripcion: Use locale-appropriate date formats
campos.hacer: Use relative or locale-aware dates

campos.descripcion: Format large numbers for readability
campos.hacer: Use thousand separators or abbreviations

campos.descripcion: Show realistic placeholders during dev
campos.hacer: Use realistic sample data

campos.descripcion: Users should be able to skip tutorials
campos.hacer: Provide Skip and Back buttons

campos.descripcion: Help users find results faster
campos.hacer: Show predictions as user types

campos.descripcion: Dead ends frustrate users
campos.hacer: Show 'No results' with suggestions

campos.descripcion: Editing one by one is tedious
campos.hacer: Allow multi-select and bulk edit

campos.descripcion: Users need to know they talk to AI
campos.hacer: Clearly label AI generated content

campos.descripcion: Waiting for full text is slow
campos.hacer: Stream text response token by token

campos.descripcion: Elements should respond to eye tracking before pinch
campos.hacer: Scale/highlight element on look

campos.descripcion: UI needs Z-depth to separate content from environment
campos.hacer: Use glass material and z-offset

campos.descripcion: Autoplaying media consumes data and creates motion barriers
campos.hacer: Prefer click-to-play; provide pause and captions; stop off-screen and honor reduced motion
campos.no_hacer: Auto-play high-resolution loops without pause or captions

campos.descripcion: Heavy 3D/Image assets increase carbon footprint
campos.hacer: Compress and lazy load 3D models

campos.descripcion: AI needs user feedback to improve
campos.hacer: Thumps up/down or 'Regenerate'

campos.descripcion: Parallax/Scroll-jacking causes nausea
campos.hacer: Honor prefers-reduced-motion and present the final readable state without parallax or scroll-jacking

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 AA requires keyboard focus to remain at least partially visible
campos.hacer: Offset sticky UI with scroll-padding and dismiss or move persistent overlays
campos.no_hacer: Let headers footers banners or chat widgets fully cover focus

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 AAA requires keyboard focus to remain fully visible
campos.hacer: Keep the entire focused component unobscured by author-created content
campos.no_hacer: Present this enhanced AAA criterion as an AA requirement or allow persistent UI to hide any part of focus

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 AAA defines minimum area and contrast for focus indicators
campos.hacer: Use an indicator at least as large as a 2 CSS px perimeter with 3:1 state contrast
campos.no_hacer: Present this enhanced AAA criterion as an AA requirement or use a thin low-contrast outline

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 AA requires a single-pointer alternative for author-controlled drag operations
campos.hacer: Add buttons menus or tap-to-move controls and retain keyboard operation
campos.no_hacer: Make dragging the only way to reorder resize or select

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 AA requires 24 CSS px pointer targets or an applicable exception
campos.hacer: Use at least 24 by 24 CSS px or verify spacing equivalent inline user-agent or essential exceptions
campos.no_hacer: Assume native 44pt or 48dp guidance defines web conformance

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 A requires repeated help mechanisms to stay in the same relative order
campos.hacer: Keep contact self-help and automated help in consistent locations
campos.no_hacer: Move help controls to different locations on each page

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 A avoids requiring the same information twice in one process
campos.hacer: Auto-populate prior values or let users select previously entered information
campos.no_hacer: Ask users to retype the same address or account data without necessity

campos.descripcion: WCAG 2.2 AA says authentication must not depend only on a cognitive function test unless an exception applies
campos.hacer: Allow password managers and paste; offer passkeys OAuth or another non-cognitive method
campos.no_hacer: Block paste or require manual OTP transcription with no alternative

campos.descripcion: Auto-rotating content needs user control
campos.hacer: Provide previous next and play/pause; stop on focus or hover and when reduced motion is requested
campos.no_hacer: Auto-advance slides without a stop control

campos.descripcion: An error summary for failed validation complements inline field errors and must be easy to find by keyboard and screen reader users
campos.hacer: Place it at the top of the form; move focus to its heading or container after failed submit; link each item to its invalid field; retain inline errors
campos.no_hacer: Replace inline errors with a visual-only summary or move focus on every blur

campos.descripcion: Short multi-line headings may use balanced wrapping as a progressive visual heuristic
campos.hacer: Bound the measure and test natural-wrap fallback across widths fonts and locales
campos.no_hacer: Promise an exact final line or insert blanket nonbreaking spaces or hardcoded br tags

campos.descripcion: URLs identifiers and user content must not force horizontal overflow
campos.hacer: Use overflow-wrap anywhere and let flex or grid text children shrink
campos.no_hacer: Apply word-break break-all to all prose

campos.descripcion: Text must remain available at narrow widths zoom and user spacing overrides
campos.hacer: Use fluid sizes content-driven height and unitless line height
campos.no_hacer: Clip text in fixed-width or fixed-height boxes

campos.descripcion: Headings actions errors safety text and distinguishing names need complete access
campos.hacer: Wrap stack resize or provide a visible full-detail path
campos.no_hacer: Clamp essential meaning only to make cards uniform

campos.descripcion: Badges communicate state while chips or tags represent values or actions
campos.hacer: Choose static or interactive markup from the label's meaning and ownership
campos.no_hacer: Make every pill clickable or encode status with color alone

campos.descripcion: Filter chips and editable value collections must preserve labels when space or text size changes
campos.hacer: Wrap the collection or use an operable +n disclosure for hidden overflow values
campos.no_hacer: Force all chips into one clipped row or hide overflow values

campos.descripcion: A badge chip or pill label should stay whole on one line when practical and disclose unavoidable truncation
campos.hacer: Bound only unpredictable values; use nowrap with a shrinkable label; expose full text to keyboard pointer and touch users
campos.no_hacer: Let one compact label wrap to a second line or use a hover-only tooltip

campos.descripcion: Interactive chips need a native role accessible name state keyboard operation and visible focus
campos.hacer: Prefer a button and expose pressed or selected state that matches the visible label
campos.no_hacer: Use a clickable div or reveal the only action on hover

campos.descripcion: Async badge and count changes should announce a meaningful contextual status without moving focus
campos.hacer: Use one appropriate atomic status message such as 3 items in cart
campos.no_hacer: Announce a bare number or make every badge a competing live region

campos.descripcion: Rapid compact-control changes can interrupt an in-flight transition
campos.hacer: Cancel or replace prior motion; set the final semantic state directly and handle cancellation cleanup
campos.no_hacer: Depend on animationend or transitionend for required state correctness
